serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Aren’t you tired? When was the last time you slept? 
You: I don’t want to sound rude, but I can hear fatigue in your voice.
#Annalie.face.eyeClosed
Lady Annalie: Haha! Thank you for your concern, but I’m fine. You don’t need to worry.
#Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.smile
Lady Annalie: I have enough caffeine in my body to stay awake for like 72 hours.
You: I don’t think that’s very healthy…
#Annalie.face.pervyGrin
Lady Annalie: Well, what doesn’t kill you makes you stronger! 
#Annalie.face.normal
Lady Annalie: To be honest, I don’t have much choice though. I need to work hard and resume the business or I will have no way to pay my bills.
